note: mapping_basis=data_labels: the .do builds item = "P601A_" + string(LS06A), where LS06A is REG06A's line code (a number-preserving rename of the source line code, core model s3 pattern 2, as in the partner sibling); the dictionary's LS06A value labels tie each line code to its text. NUMBERING TRAP (checked, resolved): the printed questionnaire numbers the 601 rows 1-21 ('UNO DE LOS 21 TEMAS', filter 608F) and has NO political-participation row, while the dictionary numbers 22 lines (+23 Otros) with line 2 = 'le han impedido su participación o limitado su opinión en el ámbito político, comunitario, gremial, comite vecinal, escolar o en los ámbitos en que usted se desenvuelve?'. REG06A has lines 1 and 3-22 only (3276 records each, no line 2, no 23), so data/dictionary line k = printed row k-1 for k>=3 (P601A_3 = printed 2 'piropos' ... P601A_22 = printed 21 'armas'). The manual's prose also uses the 22-line numbering ('desde el número 20 al 22 ... lesión física'; 'desde el 1 al 22'). Printed row text vs dictionary label: 19/21 identical, two trivial differences (dictionary 'desvestirse , mostrar' for P601A_9; dictionary 'una prueba' vs printed 'un prueba' for P601A_14). The dictionary numbering is confirmed against the data by the 602 domain columns in the same file (602.1 educativo / 602.2 laboral / 602.3 comunitario), which CAPI routed by each row's domain as the manual's pp.16-17 table assigns it: among Sí answers, P601A_12 and P601A_13 have E=1 in 14/14 and 80/80 (dictionary 12-13: pregnancy expulsion and sex-for-grades 'en la institución educativa'); P601A_14 to P601A_18 have L=1 in 104/104, 71/71, 26/26, 68/68, 130/130 (pregnancy test, dismissal, transfer, maternity leave, sex-for-promotion: all work); P601A_19 has C=1 in 194/194 ('en su comunidad'); every other line is mixed (e.g. P601A_11 'la han seguido' E/L/C .23/.10/.74). Under the printed numbering P601A_13 would be the pregnancy-test (work) row and P601A_19 the forced-sex row, which the data contradict. RESP: Bookmark 6 sets 9 (NR) to missing then recode P601A (6=1)(1=2), so live 1 = No, 2 = Sí (reversed from the source's Sí 1 / No 6). Route 9: raw REG06A counts under that recode equal live in 42/42 item x resp cells; the unrecoded reading matches 0/42. Live No/Sí = raw 6/1: P601A_1 2744/532, P601A_3 1926/1350, P601A_12 3262/14, P601A_20 3216/59, P601A_22 3177/99. Dropped NR: 13 in total (0-3 per line). Live 68783 rows (the .do asserts 68783), 3276 ids, per-item n 3273-3276. validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (21 items, resp {1,2}). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): item_text = the printed 601 stem 'Durante toda su vida de estudiante, su vida laboral y/o en su vida comunitaria. ¿A usted...' joined with a space to each printed row, row number and the row's leading '..' dropped (row 18's doubled '.. ..' likewise), line-break hyphens joined ('se-xualmente', 'pornográ-ficos', 'expul-sado', 'rela-ciones'); this is the joined form the manual p.61 gives as its example ('¿A usted... la han ignorado o no la han tomado en cuenta por ser mujer?'). Source quirks kept verbatim: 'sexuales,insultos' (no space), 'correo electrónico redes sociales' (no comma), 'un prueba de embarazo', 'embarazo ?', 'armas de fuegos'. instructions = the Sección VI read-aloud text without 'ENCUESTADORA, léale lo siguiente a la mujer seleccionada:' and the unclosed opening quotation mark, kept verbatim incl. 'Por lo tanto ,'; it is respondent-facing (read to her), as in the childhood and family siblings. option_text = the printed codes 'Sí' / 'No' keyed to the live recode (1 = No, 2 = Sí); no row for NR 9. Single section_id, no section_prompt. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: INE publishes the ENSIMUP in Spanish only; all English produced by IRW.
